theorems.name: Submission.lgc_hsNormSq_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ), Continuous (fun A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k => hsNormSq A) ∧ ∀ A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k, 0 ≤ hsNormSq A ∧ hsNormSq A ≤ m * ‖A‖ ^ 2 ∧ ∀ v : Rn m, ‖A v‖ ^ 2 ≤ hsNormSq A * ‖v‖ ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
